mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, preceding economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profits and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 5.0% per annum signals aggressive policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
